articles.summary: KALISPELL, Mont., April 06, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Glacier Bancorp, Inc. (NYSE: GBCI) will report first quarter financial results after the market closes on April 23, 2026. A conference call for investors is scheduled for 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time on Friday, April 24, 2026.
articles.title: Glacier Bancorp, Inc. Announces First Quarter Earnings Release and Conference Call

articles.summary: 1st Quarter 2026 Highlights: Net income was $82.1 million for the current quarter, an increase of $18.4 million, or 29 percent, from the prior quarter net income of $63.8 million and an increase of $27.6 million, or 51 percent, from the prior year first quarter net income of $54.6 million.
articles.title: Glacier Bancorp, Inc. Announces Results For The Quarter and Period Ended March 31, 2026
